//: Copy to sweep.config.json at the project root; final-sweep.mjs reads it from there. Every key is optional. Keys starting with // are comments.
// requireSections: README headings the event or the rubric demands; a heading containing these words passes. Use an object, {"README.md": [...], "docs/judging.md": [...]}, for other files.
// facts: The facts file prove-it writes. Default: claims.json's facts path, then facts.json, data/facts.json, docs/facts.json.
// counts: Extra count rules. Each capture group is compared with the fact path at the same position. Tests and claims are built in.
// maxFileMB: Upload caps from the event's rules. A number is an error when exceeded; {"mb": 5, "level": "WARN"} only warns.
// judgeFiles: More files judges read, checked like README.md (placeholders are errors there).
// processPolicy: private or public. Default: the process: line of BULLSEYE.md.
// processFiles: Extra process files that must not be tracked under private. A leading / anchors a pattern to the project root.
// ignore: Paths the sweep never reads: vendored code, raw data.
// allow: Regular expressions; a finding whose line matches one is dropped. Prefer a sweep-ignore comment on the line itself.
// allowHttp: http:// links you checked and that have no https version.
// hypeWords and allowWords: Words added to, or removed from, the hype list.
// strictProse: true makes em dashes in judge-facing prose errors, like --strict-prose.
